edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender of the transfer call
msg.sender is used as spender in transferFrom allowance handling
block.timestamp gates the cooldown require inside _transfer
cooldown mapping is written with block.timestamp
block.timestamp is passed as Uniswap deadline in openTrading
from parameter drives blacklist, pair and fee decisions in _transfer
to parameter drives cooldown and sell-tax decisions in _transfer
amount flows from transfer into the internal _transfer call
sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom
tAmount is the token amount processed by the internal transfer
tokenAmount is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth
contractTokenBalance is read and passed to swapTokensForEth inside _transfer
loop element bot is written into the bots blacklist mapping
notbot parameter clears the bots mapping entry
buyTax parameter overwrites the _buyTax state variable
maxTxAmount parameter overwrites the _maxTxAmount state variable
_buyTax is loaded into the _feeAddr2 fee rate for buys
_sellTax is loaded into the _feeAddr2 fee rate for sells
_feeAddr1 reflection fee rate is read during _transfer value computation
_feeAddr2 team fee rate is read during _transfer value computation
bots mapping is checked to block blacklisted participants in _transfer
_isExcludedFromFee is checked before applying taxes
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send branch in _transfer
_maxTxAmount is enforced against the transfer amount
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from and to to detect buys and sells
_allowances value is decreased in transferFrom
_rOwned balances feed the sub/add reflection arithmetic
Result of the reflection arithmetic is written back to _rOwned
_rTotal is reduced inside the arithmetic of _reflectFee
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the raw ETH transfer
uniswapV2Router is the target of the fee-on-transfer swap call
uniswapV2Router is the target of addLiquidityETH
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing openTrading
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing destroyBots
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing delBot
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing manualswap
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing manualsend
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing setBuyTax
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner before executing _setMaxTxAmount
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine
_transfer performs an external token swap before finishing state updates
_transfer pushes ETH to the fee wallet via an external call mid-transfer
swapTokensForEth invokes the Uniswap router swap
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the router
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
destroyBots loop writes blacklist entries into bots
delBot clears the blacklist entry for the given address
setBuyTax conditionally assigns the _buyTax state variable
_setMaxTxAmount conditionally assigns the _maxTxAmount state variable
Uniswap swap routes through the pair which can call back into transfer before _transfer completes

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the internal transfer flow and has no independent semantics
The to parameter is a plain argument consumed by the same transfer branch logic
The amount parameter belongs to the public transfer entry point
The sender argument is only meaningful inside the transferFrom allowance flow
The recipient argument is only meaningful inside the transferFrom flow
tAmount is the internal amount symbol consumed by the transfer computation
tokenAmount is the sole input of the swap routine
The local balance is computed and immediately consumed inside _transfer
The loop element exists only within the destroyBots iteration
notbot is the only argument of the delBot setter
buyTax is the only argument of the tax setter function
maxTxAmount is the only argument of the max transaction setter
